title: Tint-able Firework Rocket
description: A Minecraft Client-side mod on Fabric that provides color tints for firework rocket.
body:
# Tint-able Firework Rocket A Minecraft Client-side mod on Fabric that provides color tints for firework rocket. ## Variants ### Flight duration - 1 second
![Flight Duration 1](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/duration_1.png) - 2 seconds
![Flight Duration 2](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/duration_2.png) - 3 seconds
![Flight Duration 3](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/duration_3.png) ### With firework stars - Contains blue firework star, 1 second flight duration
![Star color blue](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/blue_without_fade.png) - Contains white firework star fade to red, 2 seconds flight duration
![Star color with fade](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/white_to_red.png) - Multiple firework stars, red + blue + white
![Multiple firework stars](https://github.com/lonefelidae16/tintable-firework-rocket/raw/dev/md-resource/multiple-firework-stars.gif) Any resources are available under `tintable-firework-rocket` namespace, and you can modify using resource pack feature.
